mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strengthening residential construction and consumer confidence, which typically leads to higher corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where HOUST is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 8.0%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending power and corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where UNRATE > 8.0%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and the core CPI (CPIAUCSL) indicates an inflationary monetary policy response that compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL are rising, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, when the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, the resulting higher discount rates and reduced liquidity lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC for the tightening regime is below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales (RSAFS) reflect strong consumer spending and economic activity, which typically drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90.0, it signals a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO < 90.0, or the Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 9.0%, it indicates a severe labor market deterioration that significantly reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where UNRATE > 9.0%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the core CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 230.0, it signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary policy tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 230.0, or the Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.
